local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local customers = {}  -- cache id -> region
local orders_seen = 0
local completed_seen = 0

local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    orders_seen = orders_seen + 1
    local o = tool('get_order', { id = it.id })
    if o.status == 'completed' then
      completed_seen = completed_seen + 1
      local cid = it.customer_id or o.customer_id
      local region = customers[cid]
      if region == nil then
        local c = tool('get_customer', { id = cid })
        region = c.region
        customers[cid] = region
      end
      totals[region] = totals[region] + o.amount_cents
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

return { totals = totals, orders_seen = orders_seen, completed = completed_seen, unique_customers = (function() local n=0 for _ in pairs(customers) do n=n+1 end return n end)() }
